sample.task: You seriously don't know the Star Trek episode "The Way of Eden"? It's the one with the hippies and ends with their leader "Adam" eating an alien fruit and dying in a very obvious reference to Genesis 3.
sample.chosen: I apologize for any confusion earlier. Yes, I am familiar with the Star Trek episode "The Way to Eden" from the original series. You are correct that it features a group of space hippies. However, the group is led by a character named Dr. Sevrin, not Adam. A different character, named Adam, is a part of this group. The episode indeed ends with Sevrin eating an alien fruit that is poisonous to humans, leading to his death, which is a clear reference to the biblical story of Adam and Eve in the Garden of Eden from Genesis 3. Thank you for bringing up this iconic episode.
sample.rejected: I apologize for any confusion earlier. Yes, I am familiar with the Star Trek episode "The Way to Eden" from the original series. It is the twentieth episode of the Season 3 of Star Trek, first broadcast on February 21, 1969.
